# Draft:Wii u bricking

----
The WII U is a console made by nintendo in 2012 that sold poorly in it's lifetime.
The bricking issue
note:The bricking issue on wii u was tied to the consoles EMMC chip.So what happened was the EMMC will corrupt when left off for to long.The reason is because the wii u uses a faulty EMMC that is prone to faliure.This faulty chip was commonly in most black wii u consoles.If your wii u consoles EMMC chip is Toshiba or samsung,you have a lower risk of memory corruption.
